notes.title: QualityScaler 2.5
notes.content:
[b]NEW[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 2 new RRDB AI models ( [b]BSRGANx2[/b], [b]RealESRGANx4 [/b])
[*] Added 2 new SRVGGNetCompact AI models  SRVGGNetCompact ([b]RealESR_Gx4[/b], [b]RealSRx4_Anime[/b])
[*] Removed older RRDB AI models with [b]lower upscale[/b] quality
[/list]
[b]GUI[/b]
[list]
[*] The app will now report the [b]remaining time[/b] to complete video upscaling
[*] The app now reports the [b]progress in %[/b] instead of the number of frames
[*] Updated info texts
[/list]
[b]BUGFIXES / IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Drastically reduced [b]CPU utilization by 90%[/b] without impacting upscale speed
[*] Updated dependencies
[*] General code cleaning and improvements
[/list]
